## What it catches

Only `index.ts`, `facade.ts`, and files under `src/adapters/` may import the package's own adapters; test files may also import `src/adapters/tests/`, but no other file may.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "domain-does-not-import-adapters",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^(packages/[^/]+)/src/",
    "pathNot": [
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/adapters(?:/|$)",
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/index[.]ts$",
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/facade[.]ts$"
    ]
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^$1/src/adapters(?:/|$)",
    "pathNot": "^$1/src/adapters/tests(?:/|$)"
  }
}
```
